tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (9.5:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-void
tokens.usage: Infinite virtual void, cosmic depth, mystery. Used as text on `.card-badge`, `.btn-primary`, `.badge-success`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-holographic-pink
